#v8-map-wrap .v8-map-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#ebf5ff;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;margin:0 0 7px 1px;min-height:23px}
#v8-map-hide{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1!important;width:23px!important;height:23px!important;border-radius:6px!important;color:#ccebf5!important;border-color:#679bb8!important}
#v8-map{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:auto!important;max-width:252px!important;aspect-ratio:252 / 164!important;background:#1b3e46;border:1px solid #547d8b;border-radius:9px!important;box-sizing:border-box;image-rendering:auto!important}
#v8-map-legend{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:13px;padding:7px 0 1px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#b6d6dd}
#v8-map-legend span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;white-space:nowrap}
.lqmap-dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #07151ecc}
.lqmap-dot.player{background:#ffda86;border:1px solid #fff2d4}.lqmap-dot.npc{background:#c9f0f3}.lqmap-dot.target{background:transparent;border:2px solid #ffdb7d;box-sizing:border-box}
@media(max-width:700px){#v8-map-wrap{left:8px!important;bottom:68px!important;width:208px!important;padding:6px!important}#v8-map-wrap .v8-map-head{font-size:10px}#v8-map-legend{font-size:9px;gap:7px}#v8-map{width:100%!important}}

/* Quest card fold button (the card itself ignores the mouse, so the button turns it back on). */
#v8-nav-toggle{position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #679bb8;background:#213957;color:#eaf3ff;font-size:15px;line-height:1;padding:0}
#v8-nav-toggle:hover{background:#2f5074}
#v8-compass{padding-right:26px}
#v8-navigation.collapsed{padding:4px;width:auto;background:#121e31cc}
#v8-navigation.collapsed>:not(#v8-nav-toggle){display:none!important}
#v8-navigation.collapsed #v8-nav-toggle{position:static;width:auto;height:24px;padding:0 9px;font-size:12px}
/* ART DISTRICT — same LIFEQUEST chat shell, individual street-art accents. */
#chat[data-npc-theme] {
  border-color: var(--npc-accent, #5a6a9a);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px #000b, inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--npc-accent) 24%, transparent);
}
#chat[data-npc-theme] .name { color: var(--npc-accent); text-shadow: 0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--npc-accent) 35%, transparent); }
#chat[data-npc-theme] .goal { border-left: 3px solid var(--npc-accent); padding-left: 9px; }
#chat[data-npc-theme] input:focus { border-color: var(--npc-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--npc-accent) 22%, transparent); }
#chat[data-npc-theme] #npc-suggest { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--npc-accent) 70%, #26364c); }
#chat[data-npc-theme="rook"] { --npc-accent: #e7a1ff; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="vex"] { --npc-accent: #35d5df; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="morrow"] { --npc-accent: #b79aff; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="noor"] { --npc-accent: #ff5d9b; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="ivo"] { --npc-accent: #42dce7; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="ada"] { --npc-accent: #ffbd52; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="kai"] { --npc-accent: #ff8b54; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="mira"] { --npc-accent: #83d58b; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="ren"] { --npc-accent: #70bfff; }
#chat[data-npc-theme="sol"] { --npc-accent: #c39cff; }


/* V12.3 - Map travel selector: responsive list of the real game worlds. */
.l11-map-summary{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.l11-map-summary b{color:#fff}
.l11-map-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.l11-map-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#182d43,#102136);border:1px solid #44627e;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #030c1a4d;transition:transform .18s,border-color .18s}
.l11-map-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#96c8ee}
.l11-map-card.is-current{border-color:#d9ae63;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #d9ae6355,0 8px 22px #030c1a55}
.l11-map-visual{min-height:88px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#1d5c83,#2c776b 57%,#3b6952)}
.l11-map-visual::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -5% -42% -5%;height:90%;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#ffffff2c,#00000019);transform:rotate(-8deg);border-top:3px solid #ffffff22;z-index:-1}
.l11-map-mine{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#294d64,#655e4a 64%,#333b4b)}
.l11-map-art{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#543777,#a0477c 54%,#3b5a7f)}
.l11-map-past{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#75694b,#7f8758 50%,#3e685d)}
.l11-map-symbol{font-size:43px;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 6px #050a18a8);line-height:1}
.l11-map-number{position:absolute;top:9px;right:10px;font:700 10px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#f0f7ff;background:#0615227d;padding:4px 7px;border:1px solid #ffffff2a;border-radius:999px}
.l11-map-content{display:flex;flex:1;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:14px 16px 16px}
.l11-map-region{font:800 10px system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#f2cf85}
#l11-page .l11-map-content h4{margin:0;color:#f4f7ff;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35}
#l11-page .l11-map-content p{color:#b8cddd;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;margin:0 0 10px;flex:1}
.l11-map-content button{align-self:stretch;border:1px solid #8dc0ee;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#256ab1,#2e7cba);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;padding:10px 9px;cursor:pointer;min-height:40px}
.l11-map-content button:hover:not(:disabled){background:linear-gradient(120deg,#398bd4,#359bd0)}
.l11-map-content button:disabled{cursor:default;color:#ffe7a7;background:#55452c;border-color:#997849}
#l11-page .l11-map-notice{color:#a9c5d9;font-size:11px;margin:15px 0 0;line-height:1.6}
@media (max-width:740px){.l11-map-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.l11-map-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px minmax(0,1fr)}.l11-map-visual{min-height:100%;height:100%;}.l11-map-symbol{font-size:35px}.l11-map-number{font-size:8px;right:4px;top:7px}.l11-map-content{padding:12px}.l11-map-content button{min-height:38px}}
@media (max-width:340px){.l11-map-card{grid-template-columns:68px minmax(0,1fr)}.l11-map-symbol{font-size:29px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.l11-map-card{transition:none}}

/* V13: each destination now previews its authored environmental landmarks. */
.l11-map-features{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin:-3px 0 12px}
.l11-map-features span{font:700 9px/1.35 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#cbdff3;background:#21364c;border:1px solid #415771;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 6px;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.l11-map-card:hover .l11-map-features span{border-color:#678bb1}
@media(max-width:480px){.l11-map-features span:nth-child(n+3){display:none}}
.l11-map-tracked{display:block;color:#f2d38e;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.015em;margin:-4px 0 9px}

</style>

<!-- LifeQuest V51: additive gameplay styles. -->
<style>
/* LIFEQUEST V51 – responsive isolated HUD. Does not restyle existing pixels/NPCs. */
#lq51-root{font:13px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:#eaf3ff}
#lq51-root [hidden]{display:none!important}
#lq51-root button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
#lq51-open{position:fixed;z-index:47;right:15px;bottom:77px;min-height:37px;padding:8px 12px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#254a5f,#172b45);border:1px solid #7fd6d3;border-radius:10px;color:#e2fff6;font-weight:760;box-shadow:0 5px 24px #0008}
#lq51-open:hover{background:#335b74}
#lq51-open small{font-size:9px;color:#d8ca87;vertical-align:top;margin-left:6px}
#lq51-prompt{position:fixed;z-index:48;left:50%;bottom:78px;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:min(470px,82vw);padding:8px 14px;background:#172b41ef;color:#f5e7b7;border:1px solid #c5ad78;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0009;font-weight:740;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden}
#lq51-prompt:hover{background:#344967}
#lq51-direction{position:fixed;bottom:121px;right:15px;z-index:41;font-size:11px;padding:7px 11px;background:#10283ce8;border:1px solid #709eac;border-radius:9px;max-width:250px;color:#d3e9f8}
#lq51-toast{position:fixed;z-index:390;top:17%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:11px 18px;max-width:90vw;background:#173e3bef;border:1px solid #a5e6c6;color:#e6fff2;border-radius:11px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #000a;text-align:center;font-weight:700}
#lq51-dialog{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:360;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#030915ce;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box}
#lq51-dialog .lq51-panel{width:min(980px,100%);height:min(790px,92vh);background:linear-gradient(157deg,#162b40,#0f192a 88%);border:1px solid #60839d;box-shadow:0 24px 75px #000c;border-radius:17px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
#lq51-root .lq51-header{padding:14px 19px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #3f6078;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#24455b,#172b44)}
#lq51-root .lq51-header small{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#98d1cd}
#lq51-root .lq51-header h2{font-size:24px;line-height:1.1;margin:3px 0;color:#ffdfa8}
#lq51-context{font-size:11px;color:#b7d1e4}
#lq51-close{font-size:20px!important;background:#263d53;border:1px solid #6891aa;border-radius:9px;width:38px;height:38px;color:white}
#lq51-root .lq51-tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;overflow:auto;flex:none;background:#13273b;padding:9px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #334d65}
#lq51-root .lq51-tabs button{flex:1 0 auto;border:1px solid #3f5a72;background:#21374d;color:#c6dbea;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 11px;font-size:12px}
#lq51-root .lq51-tabs button.selected{background:#32657c;border-color:#95d6db;color:white;font-weight:700}
#lq51-content{padding:17px 21px;overflow:auto;flex:1;user-select:text}
#lq51-root .lq51-panel footer{padding:10px 16px;color:#93b6c6;border-top:1px solid #344c61;font-size:10px;background:#112336;text-align:center}
#lq51-content h2{font-size:22px;margin:8px 0 12px;line-height:1.25;color:#fce0aa}
#lq51-content h3{font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;margin:15px 0 9px;color:#d9edf8}
#lq51-content p{line-height:1.58}
#lq51-content button{background:#244560;color:#eaf5ff;border:1px solid #6c9abc;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 11px}
#lq51-content button:hover{background:#306685}
#lq51-content button:focus-visible,#lq51-close:focus-visible,#lq51-open:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffdd8b;outline-offset:2px}
#lq51-content button.selected{border-color:#f9d48d;background:#35536b}
#lq51-content button.lq51-primary{background:#2d7474;border-color:#8ddbd0;font-weight:750;margin-top:9px}
.lq51-hero{padding:20px;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#20495d,#222d50);border:1px solid #5c8295;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff0a;margin-bottom:17px}
.lq51-hero small{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#9adfda;font-weight:750}
.lq51-hero h2{font-size:25px!important;margin:4px 0 6px!important}
.lq51-hero p{margin:4px 0 10px;color:#c8dde9}
.lq51-pill{display:inline-block;background:#204b4f;color:#b3f0dd;border:1px solid #487f80;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:30px;font-size:11px}
.lq51-sectionhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:9px 0 10px}
.lq51-sectionhead h3{margin:0!important}.lq51-sectionhead span{font-size:11px;color:#a9c8d8}
.lq51-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:12px}
.lq51-card{padding:15px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#192f45;border:1px solid #416379;border-radius:12px;min-height:183px}
.lq51-card strong{font-size:16px;color:#f4e6c4;margin:8px 0 3px}
.lq51-card p{color:#b8d1e0;font-size:12px;flex:1;margin:5px 0 13px}
.lq51-card-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:#adc6d3}
.lq51-card-top .lq51-glyph{font:bold 17px monospace;display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:6px;background:#466577;color:#ffe6ad;border:1px solid #6f94a3}
.lq51-done{color:#91edc0!important}
.lq51-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:8px 0}
.lq51-advice,.lq51-note{font-size:11px;color:#a8bdcc;background:#15283b;border-left:3px solid #7ea8af;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:6px;margin-top:15px}
.lq51-back{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:12px;color:#8abed4;font-size:11px}
.lq51-desc{color:#bad2df;background:#1b3447;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid #3e6279;padding:12px;margin:10px 0 17px}
.lq51-step{color:#96dacb;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em}
.lq51-answers{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;margin:15px 0 8px}
.lq51-answers button{text-align:left;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#1f3850!important;padding:12px!important;border-radius:9px!important}
.lq51-answers button:hover{background:#315d7a!important;border-color:#a0d8e9!important}
.lq51-answers button span{background:#385b70;border:1px solid #7291a5;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700}
.lq51-error{background:#472c39;color:#ffc6c3;border:1px solid #bc7984;padding:10px 12px;margin-top:13px;border-radius:8px}
.lq51-success{background:#1d4b42;color:#bcf4d6;border:1px solid #68bfa2;padding:10px 12px;margin-top:13px;border-radius:8px}
.lq51-small,.lq51-muted{color:#b4c9d8;font-size:12px}
#lq51-writing{display:block;background:#0c1d2e;color:#f0f7fc;border:1px solid #7197a8;border-radius:9px;padding:12px;min-height:115px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;margin:8px 0;font:13px/1.6 system-ui;resize:vertical}
.lq51-art{padding:13px;background:#101e34;border:1px solid #415774;border-radius:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;margin:16px auto;width:max-content;max-width:100%;color:#c8dae8;letter-spacing:.11em;font-size:10px}
.lq51-pixels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,19px);grid-template-rows:repeat(8,19px);image-rendering:pixelated;border:8px solid #524a54;box-shadow:0 7px 20px #000a}
.lq51-pixels i{width:19px;height:19px;display:block}
.lq51-colorchoices{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.lq51-colorchoices button{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;font-size:12px}
.lq51-colorchoices span{height:20px;width:45px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #9db1aa}
.lq51-label{font-size:12px;color:#bed5e4;font-weight:800;margin:17px 0 6px}
.lq51-regions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:9px}
.lq51-region{padding:12px;background:#1b3448;border:1px solid #41647b;border-radius:10px;display:grid;gap:5px}
.lq51-region b{font-size:12px;color:#dfedfc}.lq51-region span{font-size:11px;color:#93c3d6}
.lq51-meter{height:6px;background:#31445b;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden}.lq51-meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:#88d5b5}
.lq51-timeline{border-left:2px solid #6290b0;background:#1a3044;padding:9px 12px;margin:7px 0;font-size:12px}.lq51-timeline small{display:block;color:#95b2c7}
.lq51-npc{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border:1px solid #35546a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin:7px 0;background:#172c40}
.lq51-npc div{display:grid;gap:2px}.lq51-npc strong{font-size:13px}.lq51-npc small{font-size:10px;color:#90b5ce}.lq51-npc span{font-size:11px;color:#9ce3cf}
.lq51-debug{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(100px,1fr) 1fr;gap:9px 12px;background:#182f43;padding:15px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #42647b}
.lq51-debug div{color:#9fc3d3}.lq51-debug b{font:600 12px monospace;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
body.lq-mine-playing #lq51-open,body.lq-mine-playing #lq51-prompt,body.lq-mine-playing #lq51-direction{visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
@media(max-width:680px){#lq51-dialog{padding:5px}#lq51-dialog .lq51-panel{height:96dvh;border-radius:10px}#lq51-content{padding:12px}#lq51-root .lq51-header{padding:11px}#lq51-root .lq51-header h2{font-size:18px}.lq51-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#lq51-open{bottom:134px;right:8px;padding:7px 10px}#lq51-prompt{bottom:132px;font-size:11px}#lq51-direction{bottom:181px;right:8px;max-width:155px}.lq51-hero{padding:14px}}

</style>

<!-- V52 dynamic interactive ecosystem, original pixel art intact -->
<style>
/* V52 overlay is independent of original LifeQuest menus, graphics and sprites. */
#lq52-root{font:13px/1.56 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:#eaf3ff;pointer-events:none}
#lq52-root [hidden]{display:none!important}
#lq52-root button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;color:#f3f9ff;border:1px solid #648ca7;border-radius:9px;background:#25435b;padding:8px 12px;pointer-events:auto}
#lq52-root button:hover{background:#38607a}
#lq52-chip{position:fixed;bottom:126px;right:14px;z-index:46;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#204736,#1d384e)!important;border-color:#74b79a!important;color:#bff4de!important;font-weight:780!important;max-width:min(300px,52vw);box-shadow:0 8px 20px #0008;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden}
#lq52-prompt{position:fixed;bottom:124px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:48;background:#18364cde!important;border-color:#efc985!important;color:#ffe4ac!important;font-weight:770!important;max-width:min(450px,70vw);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#lq52-toast{position:fixed;top:17%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:408;max-width:min(520px,90vw);padding:12px 17px;background:#193c36f2;border:1px solid #85ddaa;border-radius:12px;color:#e2ffed;box-shadow:0 9px 35px #000a;pointer-events:none;text-align:center;font-weight:700}
#lq52-modal,#lq52-menu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:405;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;box-sizing:border-box;background:#050c1ad2;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);pointer-events:auto}
#lq52-modal .lq52-panel,#lq52-menu .lq52-panel{width:min(600px,100%);max-height:min(760px,89vh);overflow:auto;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#1a3548,#0e1b2f);border:1px solid #6c9aa6;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 18px 55px #000c;padding:20px 23px;color:#dceef7}
#lq52-menu .lq52-panel{width:min(760px,100%)}
#lq52-root .lq52-panel header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;border-bottom:1px solid #42647a;margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:10px}
#lq52-root .lq52-panel header b{font-size:19px;line-height:1.3;color:#f9dba5}
#lq52-root .lq52-panel header button{font-size:17px;padding:3px 10px}
#lq52-description{white-space:pre-line;color:#d0e6ee;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}
#lq52-actions,.lq52-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
#lq52-root button.primary{background:#31735d!important;border-color:#9bdcb9!important;font-weight:760}
#lq52-root button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffdda3;outline-offset:2px}
#lq52-root .lq52-card{margin:12px 0;padding:14px 16px;background:#1b3547;border:1px solid #446979;border-radius:12px}
#lq52-root .lq52-card b{font-size:14px;color:#f3e3be}

<meta name="lifequest-build" content="V56-accessible-entrances" /></head>
  <body>
<img id="lq-v47-npc-atlas" alt="" aria-hidden="true" width="290" height="210" style="position:fixed;width:0;height:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0" src="data:image/png;base64,">
    <!-- React Root handles the overlay UI, cheatsheet guide, status indicators, and mounting -->
    <div id="root"></div>

    <!-- 2D Canvas Container -->
    <div id="game"></div>

    <button id="v10-open" type="button" style="position:fixed;right:148px;top:13px;z-index:9001" title="Smart economy (B)">💰 Economy (B)</button>
    <!-- NPC Chat Overlay -->
    <div id="chat">
      <button type="button" id="chat-close" title="Leave conversation (Esc)" aria-label="Leave conversation">✕</button>
      <div class="name"></div>
      <div class="goal"></div>
      <button type="button" id="v10-npc-shop" hidden>🛒 Open shop (B)</button>
      <div class="npc-coach">
        <button id="npc-suggest" type="button" title="Suggest 3 English sentences that fit the conversation">✨ AI sentence suggestions</button>
        <div id="npc-suggestions" aria-label="English reply suggestions"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="log"></div>
      <div class="inrow">
        <input type="text" placeholder="Type in English and press Enter, or press the mic and speak..." autocomplete="off" />
        <button id="mic" type="button" title="Speak English (Tab)">🎤</button>
      </div>
      <div class="hint">
        Enter: send &nbsp;|&nbsp; Tab: speak (microphone) &nbsp;|&nbsp; Esc: leave conversation &nbsp;|&nbsp; ?word: explain a word &nbsp;|&nbsp; 
        <button id="teacher" type="button" title="AI teacher fixes your grammar under each message">✎ Teacher: ON</button> &nbsp;
        <button id="voice-toggle" type="button" title="Toggle NPC voice">🔊 Voice: ON</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Quest Briefing Overlay -->
    <div id="briefing">
      <div class="name"></div>
      <div class="text"></div>
      <div class="row">
        <span class="hint">E / Space / Enter: continue &nbsp;|&nbsp; Esc: stay here</span>
        <span><span class="step"></span><button class="next" type="button">Next ▸</button></span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Word Helper (Vietnamese English Explanations) -->
    <div id="helper">
      <h3>📖 Word helper - ask about any hard word</h3>
      <div class="row">
        <input type="text" placeholder="Type a word, a phrase or a sentence (you can also ask in Vietnamese)" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" />
        <button id="helper-ask" type="button">Explain</button>
        <button id="helper-close" type="button">Close</button>
      </div>
      <div class="hout">
        <div class="wnote">Example: <b>polite</b>, <b>take care of</b>, or "How much does it cost?"</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hbook"></div>
      <div class="wnote">In a chat, type <b>?word</b> to ask without leaving the conversation. H: close</div>
    </div>

    <!-- Player Journal -->
    <div id="journal"></div>

    <!-- Quests Log -->
    <div id="quests"></div>

    <!-- Notification Toast -->
    <div id="toast"></div>

    <!-- Quick Group Menu Button & Menu -->
    <button id="group-btn" type="button" title="Open the menu (G)">☰ Menu (G)</button>
    <div id="group-menu">
      <button type="button" data-act="talk"><span>💬 Talk / sleep</span><kbd>E</kbd></button>
      <button type="button" data-act="quests"><span>📜 Quests</span><kbd>Q</kbd></button>
      <button type="button" data-act="journal"><span>📓 Journal</span><kbd>J</kbd></button>
      <button type="button" data-act="helper"><span>📖 Word helper</span><kbd>H</kbd></button>
      <button type="button" data-act="settings"><span>⚙ AI settings</span><kbd>K</kbd></button>
      <div class="sep"></div>
      <button type="button" data-act="reset"><span>🗑 Erase all progress</span><kbd>F8</kbd></button>
      <div class="tip">Move: WASD / arrows. At a door press W to enter. G: open or close this menu.</div>
    </div>

    <!-- Technical inputs are retained for backwards compatibility with the existing AI engine;
         no Gemini setup controls are displayed in the player interface. -->
    <div id="settings">
      <h3>⚙️ Storage &amp; data</h3>
      <p style="font-size:13px;color:#bcd0e4">Export or import your game progress. Existing AI settings are kept; no API key is required to enter the game.</p>
      <div hidden aria-hidden="true">
        <input id="ai-key" type="password" autocomplete="off" />
        <input id="ai-model" type="text" autocomplete="off" />
        <button id="ai-save" type="button">Save</button><button id="ai-test" type="button">Test</button><button id="ai-clear" type="button">Clear</button>
      </div>
      <div class="row"><button id="ai-close" type="button">Close</button></div>
      <div class="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
      <h3>💾 Progress backup</h3>
      <div class="row"><button id="save-export">Export save</button><button id="save-import">Import save</button><input id="save-file" type="file" accept=".json,application/json" style="display:none" /></div>
      <p class="note">Data is never deleted or reset automatically on upgrades.</p>
    </div>

</section>

<div class="lq-modal" id="lq-guide" hidden><div class="lq-dialog"><h2>🗺️ English Town guide</h2><p>Move with <b>WASD</b> or the <b>arrow keys</b>. Press <b>E</b> next to an NPC to chat in English; press <b>W / ↑</b> to enter a building door. Inside, press <b>E</b> near the stairs to change floors or near objects to explore. Press <b>G</b> to open the menu, <b>Q</b> for quests, <b>H</b> for the word helper, <b>K</b> for Gemini settings.</p><p>🤖 Press the <b>AI companion</b> button and give a command such as “đến Lily và nói chuyện” (go to Lily and talk), “đến bệnh viện” (go to the hospital), “đi sang phải 2 giây” (walk right for 2 seconds) or “dừng” (stop). The character walks by itself if a path is found.</p><p>💬 In an NPC dialogue, press <b>✨ AI sentence suggestions</b> to get three fitting English sentences. The AI assistant recognises whether you want to chat, learn or control the game, and offers flashcards, a word book and quiz stats; try “Lily là ai?” (who is Lily?), “sửa câu: I goes to school” (fix a sentence), “quiz”, “từ vựng: library” (vocabulary) or “luyện hội thoại” (conversation practice).</p><p>New here? Replay the opening scene and the step-by-step tutorial from Menu → Settings → 🎬 Intro &amp; tutorial. The game also runs without Internet (the NPCs then use their offline replies). Online Gemini AI needs an API key in section K; never write the key into the source code when publishing a public website.</p><div class="lq-actions"><button id="guide-close" type="button">Got it</button></div></div></div>

<script>
/* Auto-repair: nếu model đã lưu/mặc định không còn tồn tại (404), tự chọn model Gemini Flash ổn định mới nhất cho key này và lưu lại. */
(function(){
  const KEY='english-town-ai';
  const read=()=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'{}')||{}}catch{return {}}};
  async function repair(){
    try{
      const saved=read();
      const key=String(saved.geminiKey||window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG?.GEMINI_API_KEY||'').trim();
      if(!key)return;
      const model=String(saved.geminiModel||window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG?.MODEL||'gemini-2.5-flash').trim();
      const H={'x-goog-api-key':key};
      const chk=await fetch('https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/'+encodeURIComponent(model),{headers:H});
      if(chk.status!==404)return;
      const r=await fetch('https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?pageSize=200',{headers:H});
      if(!r.ok)return;
      const list=((await r.json()).models||[]).filter(m=>(m.supportedGenerationMethods||[]).includes('generateContent'))
        .map(m=>m.name.replace(/^models\//,'')).filter(n=>/^gemini-[\d.]+-flash(-lite)?$/.test(n));
      const ver=n=>(n.match(/gemini-([\d.]+)/)[1]).split('.').map(Number);
      const cmp=(a,b)=>{const x=ver(a),y=ver(b);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const d=(y[i]||0)-(x[i]||0);if(d)return d;}return 0;};
      list.sort((a,b)=>(/lite/.test(a)-/lite/.test(b))||cmp(a,b));
      if(!list.length)return;
      saved.geminiModel=list[0];
      localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(saved));
      console.info('[LIFEQUEST] Model "'+model+'" no longer exists (404) -> using "'+list[0]+'"');
    }catch(e){console.warn('[LIFEQUEST] model repair skipped',e)}
  }
  window.__lqModelReady=repair();
})();

</script>

<script>
/*
 * Dandelion artwork, drawn with code (no image file needed).
 *  - LQDandelion.icon(size)  -> small SVG logo (string)
 *  - LQDandelion.mount(canvas) -> draws the big dandelion at dusk with seeds drifting in the wind;
 *                                 returns a function that stops the animation.
 */
(function () {
  const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
  const rnd = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

  function icon(size) {
    const n = 26,
      parts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * TAU,
        r = i % 2 ? 11 : 13.5;
      const x1 = 24 + Math.cos(a) * 3,
        y1 = 21 + Math.sin(a) * 3,
        x2 = 24 + Math.cos(a) * r,
        y2 = 21 + Math.sin(a) * r;
      parts.push(
        `<line x1="${x1.toFixed(2)}" y1="${y1.toFixed(2)}" x2="${x2.toFixed(2)}" y2="${y2.toFixed(2)}"/>` +
          `<circle cx="${x2.toFixed(2)}" cy="${y2.toFixed(2)}" r="1.3" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>`,
      );
    }
    return `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true">${parts.join('')}<circle cx="24" cy="21" r="2.4" fill="#ffd36b" stroke="none"/><path d="M24 24c0 8-2 14-4 20" stroke="#7bd49a" stroke-width="1.8"/></svg>`;
  }

  function mount(cv) {
    const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
    const reduce = window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1, bg = null, puff = null, geo = null, seeds = [], raf = 0, last = 0, stopped = false;

    const offscreen = (w, h) => {
      const c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.width = Math.ceil(w * dpr);
      c.height = Math.ceil(h * dpr);
      const x = c.getContext('2d');
      x.scale(dpr, dpr);
      return [c, x];
    };

    function makeBg() {
      const [c, x] = offscreen(W, H);
      const g = x.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      g.addColorStop(0, '#10193a');
      g.addColorStop(0.42, '#2b4a86');
      g.addColorStop(0.72, '#e29a6b');
      g.addColorStop(1, '#f3c58f');
      x.fillStyle = g;
      x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      // soft sun glow near the horizon
      const sun = x.createRadialGradient(W * 0.72, H * 0.78, 0, W * 0.72, H * 0.78, H * 0.55);
      sun.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,214,160,.85)');
      sun.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,214,160,0)');
      x.fillStyle = sun;
      x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      // bokeh
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        x.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${rnd(0.04, 0.11)})`;
        x.beginPath();
        x.arc(rnd(0, W), rnd(0, H * 0.7), rnd(8, 34), 0, TAU);
        x.fill();
      }
      // rolling hills and grass in front
      const hill = (base, amp, col, f, ph) => {
        x.fillStyle = col;
        x.beginPath();
        x.moveTo(0, H);
        for (let px = 0; px <= W; px += 6) x.lineTo(px, H - base - amp * Math.sin(px / f + ph));
        x.lineTo(W, H);
        x.fill();
      };
      hill(H * 0.15, H * 0.035, '#27506a', W / 5, 1);
      hill(H * 0.09, H * 0.03, '#183a4f', W / 4, 3);
      x.strokeStyle = '#0d2434';
      x.lineWidth = 1.4;
      for (let px = 0; px < W; px += 5) {
        const h = rnd(H * 0.03, H * 0.09);
        x.beginPath();
        x.moveTo(px, H);
        x.quadraticCurveTo(px + rnd(-6, 6), H - h * 0.6, px + rnd(-10, 10), H - h);
        x.stroke();
      }
      return c;
    }

    function makePuff(R) {
      const S = R * 2.7;
      const [c, x] = offscreen(S, S);
      const m = S / 2;
      const glow = x.createRadialGradient(m, m, R * 0.2, m, m, R * 1.3);
      glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,.28)');
      glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      x.fillStyle = glow;
      x.fillRect(0, 0, S, S);
      // filaments on a sphere, back to front
      const pts = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 190; i++) {
        const z = rnd(-1, 1),
          p = rnd(0, TAU),
          q = Math.sqrt(1 - z * z);
        pts.push({ x: q * Math.cos(p), y: q * Math.sin(p), z });
      }
      pts.sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z);
      x.lineCap = 'round';
      for (const p of pts) {
        const depth = (p.z + 1) / 2;
        const a = 0.22 + 0.62 * depth;
        const tx = m + p.x * R,
          ty = m + p.y * R;
        x.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(a * 0.75).toFixed(3)})`;
        x.lineWidth = 0.7 + depth * 0.5;
        x.beginPath();
        x.moveTo(m, m);
        x.lineTo(tx, ty);
        x.stroke();
        // feathery tip
        const tr = R * (0.04 + depth * 0.025);
        x.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(a * 0.9).toFixed(3)})`;
        x.lineWidth = 0.6;
        for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
          const ang = (k / 10) * TAU;
          x.beginPath();
          x.moveTo(tx, ty);
          x.lineTo(tx + Math.cos(ang) * tr, ty + Math.sin(ang) * tr);
          x.stroke();
        }
        x.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(a * 0.9).toFixed(3)})`;
        x.beginPath();
        x.arc(tx, ty, 1.1, 0, TAU);
        x.fill();
      }
      x.fillStyle = '#c9d49a';
      x.beginPath();
      x.arc(m, m, R * 0.055, 0, TAU);
      x.fill();
      return c;
    }

    // A seed starts on the flower (so it looks like it just left the bloom) or, at first, somewhere in the air.
    const newSeed = (anywhere) => {
      let x, y;
      if (anywhere && Math.random() < 0.5) {
        x = rnd(0, W);
        y = rnd(0, H * 0.85);
      } else {
        const a = rnd(-1.3, 1.0),
          r = geo.R * rnd(0.55, 1.0);
        x = geo.cx + Math.cos(a) * r;
        y = geo.cy + Math.sin(a) * r;
      }
      return { x, y, s: rnd(5, 11), vx: rnd(9, 20), vy: rnd(-12, -4), rot: rnd(-0.7, 0.7), ph: rnd(0, TAU), a: rnd(0.5, 0.9) };
    };
    function drawSeed(s, t) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(s.x + Math.sin(t / 900 + s.ph) * 6, s.y);
      ctx.rotate(s.rot + Math.sin(t / 1300 + s.ph) * 0.15);
      ctx.globalAlpha = s.a;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
      for (let k = 0; k <= 10; k++) {
        const ang = -Math.PI + (k / 10) * Math.PI;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(ang) * s.s, Math.sin(ang) * s.s * 0.9);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(Math.cos(ang) * s.s, Math.sin(ang) * s.s * 0.9, 0.9, 0, TAU);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(0, s.s * 1.7);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2f26';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, s.s * 1.85, 1.1, 2.2, 0, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    function layout() {
      dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
      W = Math.max(2, Math.round(r.width));
      H = Math.max(2, Math.round(r.height));
      cv.width = W * dpr;
      cv.height = H * dpr;
      geo = { cx: W * 0.52, cy: H * 0.4, R: Math.min(W * 0.33, H * 0.27) };
      bg = makeBg();
      puff = makePuff(geo.R);
      seeds = Array.from({ length: W < 500 ? 8 : 16 }, () => newSeed(true));
    }

    function draw(t, dt) {
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.drawImage(bg, 0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#2f6e4e';
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, geo.R * 0.045);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(geo.cx, geo.cy);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(geo.cx - geo.R * 0.16, (geo.cy + H) / 2, geo.cx - geo.R * 0.05, H + 10);
      ctx.stroke();
      const pw = puff.width / dpr;
      ctx.drawImage(puff, geo.cx - pw / 2, geo.cy - pw / 2, pw, pw);
      ctx.restore();
      for (const s of seeds) {
        if (!reduce) {
          s.x += s.vx * dt;
          s.y += s.vy * dt;
          if (s.x > W + 30 || s.y < -30) Object.assign(s, newSeed(false));
        }
        drawSeed(s, t);
      }
      const v = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.35, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
      v.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(5,8,20,0)');
      v.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(5,8,20,.45)');
      ctx.fillStyle = v;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }

    function frame(now) {
      if (stopped) return;
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - (last || now)) / 1000);
      last = now;
      draw(now, dt);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    layout();
    window.addEventListener('resize', layout);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', layout);
    };
  }

  window.LQDandelion = { icon, mount };
})();

</script>
    <script>
/*
 * Accounts and cloud saves (Supabase).
 *
 * - Players can sign in with email + password or Google, or play as a guest (progress stays on this device).
 * - While signed in, the game save (and a few settings) is copied to the table public.saves and restored on
 *   any other device after signing in.
 * - Without SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in js/config.js everything here stays off and the game works as before.
 *
 * See SUPABASE_SETUP.md for the one-time setup.
 */
(function () {
  const CFG = window.LIFEQUEST_AI_CONFIG || {};
  const URL_ = String(CFG.SUPABASE_URL || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const ANON = String(CFG.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || '');
  const ENABLED = !!(URL_ && ANON);
  const SDK = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.45.4/dist/umd/supabase.js';

  const META_KEY = 'lq-sync-meta'; // not synced: describes this device
  const SAVE_KEY = 'english-town-save-v1';
  const PUSH_DELAY = 15000;
  const MAX_BYTES = 1500000;

  const nativeSet = Storage.prototype.setItem;
  const nativeRemove = Storage.prototype.removeItem;
  const store = window.localStorage;

  let client = null,
    user = null,
    token = '',
    suppress = false,
    blockWrites = false,
    pushTimer = 0,
    busy = false,
    statusText = '',
    chip = null,
    lastCheck = 0;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  const isSyncKey = (k) =>
    typeof k === 'string' &&
    k !== 'english-town-ai' &&
    (k === SAVE_KEY || /^lifequest[_-][a-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/i.test(k)) &&
    !/(?:key|secret|token|credential)/i.test(k);

  const syncKeys = () => {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < store.length; i++) {
      const k = store.key(i);
      if (isSyncKey(k)) out.push(k);
    }
    return out;
  };
  const snapshot = () => {
    const data = {};
    for (const k of syncKeys()) {
      const v = store.getItem(k);
      if (typeof v === 'string') data[k] = v;
    }
    return data;
  };
  const readMeta = () => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(store.getItem(META_KEY) || '{}') || {};
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  };
  const writeMeta = (patch) => {
    const m = Object.assign(readMeta(), patch);
    nativeSet.call(store, META_KEY, JSON.stringify(m));
    return m;
  };
  // The game saves itself on page unload; after we replaced or cleared the local data that would undo our work.
  function hardReload() {
    blockWrites = true;
    clearTimeout(pushTimer);
    location.reload();
  }
  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' })[c]);

  function describe(data) {
    try {
      const g = JSON.parse(data[SAVE_KEY] || 'null');
      if (!g || !g.game) return 'No progress yet';
      const look = g.game.rpg && g.game.rpg.look;
      const parts = [];
      if (look && look.name) parts.push(look.name);
      parts.push('Day ' + (g.game.day || 1));
      parts.push('$' + (g.game.money ?? 0));
      if (g.game.rpg && g.game.rpg.xp != null) parts.push(g.game.rpg.xp + ' XP');
      return parts.join(' · ');
    } catch {
      return 'Progress could not be read';
    }
  }
  const fmtDate = (iso) => {
    try {
      return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('vi-VN');
    } catch {
      return iso || '';
    }
  };

  function applySnapshot(data) {
    suppress = true;
    try {
      for (const k of syncKeys()) nativeRemove.call(store, k);
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data || {})) {
        if (isSyncKey(k) && typeof v === 'string' && v.length < 2e6) nativeSet.call(store, k, v);
      }
    } finally {
      suppress = false;
    }
  }

  // ---------- UI ----------
  const CSS = `
#lq-auth{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:97;background:#05080ef2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px;box-sizing:border-box;font:15px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#eef3ff}
#lq-auth .card{width:min(420px,100%);background:#141824;border:2px solid #5a6a9a;border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #000a}
#lq-auth h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:22px;color:#ffd36b}
#lq-auth .sub{color:#a9b8d0;margin:0 0 14px;font-size:14px}
#lq-auth .tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
#lq-auth .tabs button{flex:1;background:#1f2a3d;color:#eef3ff;border:1px solid #3b4c6b;border-radius:9px;padding:8px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
#lq-auth .tabs button.on{background:#33405a;border-color:#ffd36b}
#lq-auth label{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#a9b8d0;margin:8px 0 3px}
#lq-auth input{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#0d1320;color:#fff;border:1px solid #3b4c6b;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px;font:inherit}
#lq-auth .btn{width:100%;margin-top:12px;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:11px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
#lq-auth .primary{background:#f3b94d;color:#1b2630}
#lq-auth .google{background:#fff;color:#1f1f1f}
#lq-auth .ghost{background:#2a3550;color:#eef3ff}
#lq-auth .link{background:none;border:0;color:#8fc4ff;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;padding:6px 0 0;text-decoration:underline}
#lq-auth .msg{min-height:20px;margin-top:8px;font-size:13px}
#lq-auth .msg.err{color:#ff9a9a}#lq-auth .msg.ok{color:#9be3b0}
#lq-auth .or{text-align:center;color:#7d8aa3;font-size:12px;margin:10px 0 0}
#lq-auth .cmp{display:grid;gap:8px;margin:10px 0}
#lq-auth .cmp div{background:#0d1320;border:1px solid #3b4c6b;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:14px}
#lq-auth .cmp b{display:block;color:#ffd36b;font-size:13px}
#lq-chip{position:fixed;left:236px;top:14px;z-index:40;font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#eef3ff}
#lq-chip>button{background:#141824f2;color:#eef3ff;border:1px solid #5a6a9a;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 13px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;max-width:260px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0006}
@media (max-width:640px){#lq-chip{left:160px}#lq-chip>button{max-width:calc(100vw - 272px);padding:7px 10px}#lq-chip .menu{left:auto;right:-90px}}
#lq-chip .menu{position:absolute;top:38px;left:0;min-width:240px;background:#141824;border:1px solid #5a6a9a;border-radius:12px;padding:8px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #000a;display:none}
#lq-chip.open .menu{display:block}
#lq-chip .menu p{margin:2px 6px 8px;font-weight:400;font-size:12px;color:#a9b8d0}
#lq-chip .menu button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:#1f2a3d;color:#eef3ff;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;margin-top:4px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
#lq-chip .dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px;background:#7d8aa3}
#lq-chip .dot.ok{background:#58c26a}#lq-chip .dot.sync{background:#f3b94d}#lq-chip .dot.bad{background:#e0605a}
#lq-banner{position:fixed;left:50%;top:70px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:41;background:#1b2a3aee;border:2px solid #f3b94d;color:#ffe9a8;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 14px;font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
#lq-banner button{background:#f3b94d;color:#1b2630;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 10px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
#lq-auth.split{padding:0;align-items:stretch;justify-content:stretch;background:#0a0e1c;font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
#lq-auth.split .fpane{box-sizing:border-box;flex:0 0 40%;min-width:340px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:20px 30px 14px;position:relative;overflow:auto;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0c1124,#0a0e1c)}
#lq-auth.split .fwrap{width:100%;max-width:370px}
#lq-auth.split .brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}
#lq-auth.split .ico{color:#dbe6ff}
#lq-auth.split .word{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:26px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#fff}
#lq-auth.split .word b{font-size:.55em;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:.22em .55em;border-radius:.4em;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f8cff,#8a5cff)}
#lq-auth.split h2{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
#lq-auth.split .sub{margin:0 0 12px;color:#9aa8cc;font-size:14px}
#lq-auth.split .tabs{background:#141b33;border-radius:12px;padding:4px;gap:4px;margin-bottom:14px}
#lq-auth.split .tabs button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#9aa8cc;border-radius:9px;padding:9px;font-weight:600}
#lq-auth.split .tabs button.on{background:#27315a;color:#fff}
#lq-auth.split label{color:#aab6d8;font-size:12.5px;margin:9px 0 4px}
#lq-auth.split input{background:#111833;border:1px solid #28345e;border-radius:11px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:15px;color:#fff;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
#lq-auth.split input:focus{outline:none;border-color:#6b8cff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #4f6bff33}
#lq-auth.split .btn{border-radius:12px;padding:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-top:10px}
#lq-auth.split .primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f8cff,#7c5cff);color:#fff}
#lq-auth.split .primary:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(1.1)}
#lq-auth.split .google{background:#fff;color:#1f1f1f;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
#lq-auth [hidden]{display:none!important}
#lq-auth.split .ghost{background:transparent;color:#cfd8f2;border:1px solid #2c3866}
#lq-auth.split .ghost:hover{background:#141b33}
#lq-auth.split .or{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#6f7ea6;font-size:12px;margin:8px 0 0}
#lq-auth.split .or::before,#lq-auth.split .or::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:#222c52}
#lq-auth.split .note{background:#1a2347;border:1px solid #2c3866;color:#c8d3f2;border-radius:11px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:10px}
#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off .tabs,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off .field,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off #lq-a-go,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off #lq-a-forgot,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off #lq-a-google,#lq-auth.split .fwrap.off .or{opacity:.4;pointer-events:none}
#lq-auth.split .ffoot{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#5f6d96}
#lq-auth.split .msg{min-height:16px;margin-top:6px}#lq-auth.split .link{padding:2px 0 0}
#lq-auth.split .apane{box-sizing:border-box;flex:1 1 60%;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#lq-auth.split .apane canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
#lq-auth.split .quote{position:absolute;left:34px;bottom:26px;margin:0;max-width:60%;font-size:15px;font-style:italic;color:#ffffffd9;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #0008}
@media (max-width:820px){#lq-auth.split{flex-direction:column-reverse}#lq-auth.split .fpane{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;justify-content:flex-start;padding:22px 20px 40px}#lq-auth.split .apane{flex:0 0 26vh}#lq-auth.split .quote{display:none}}
`;
  function addCss() {
    if (document.getElementById('lq-auth-css')) return;
    const st = document.createElement('style');
    st.id = 'lq-auth-css';
    st.textContent = CSS;
    document.head.appendChild(st);
  }

  function overlay(html, split) {
    addCss();
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.id = 'lq-auth';
    if (split) {
      el.className = 'split';
      el.innerHTML = html;
    } else el.innerHTML = '<div class="card">' + html + '</div>';
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    return el;
  }
  const GOOGLE_G =
    '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="#EA4335" d="M24 9.5c3.5 0 6.6 1.2 9.1 3.6l6.8-6.8C35.8 2.4 30.3 0 24 0 14.6 0 6.5 5.4 2.6 13.2l7.9 6.1C12.4 13.6 17.7 9.5 24 9.5z"/><path fill="#4285F4" d="M46.5 24.5c0-1.6-.1-3.1-.4-4.5H24v9h12.7c-.6 3-2.3 5.5-4.8 7.2l7.5 5.8c4.4-4.1 7.1-10.1 7.1-17.5z"/><path fill="#FBBC05" d="M10.5 28.7a14.5 14.5 0 010-9.4l-7.9-6.1a24 24 0 000 21.6l7.9-6.1z"/><path fill="#34A853" d="M24 48c6.5 0 11.9-2.1 15.9-5.8l-7.5-5.8c-2.1 1.4-4.9 2.3-8.4 2.3-6.3 0-11.6-4.1-13.5-9.8l-7.9 6.1C6.5 42.6 14.6 48 24 48z"/></svg>';

  function showLogin({ allowGuest, disabled }) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let mode = 'in';
      const art = window.LQDandelion;
      const el = overlay(
        `
        <section class="fpane">
          <div class="fwrap${disabled ? ' off' : ''}">
            <div class="brand"><div class="ico">${art ? art.icon(46) : ''}</div><div class="word"><span>LIFEQUEST</span><b>AI</b></div></div>
            <h2>Welcome</h2>
            <p class="sub">Sign in to save your progress and keep playing on any device.</p>
            ${disabled ? '<div class="note">Sign-in is not enabled in this build. You can still play as a guest right now.</div>' : ''}
            <div class="tabs"><button type="button" data-m="in" class="on">Sign in</button><button type="button" data-m="up">Sign up</button></div>
            <div class="field"><label for="lq-a-mail">Email</label><input id="lq-a-mail" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@example.com"></div>
            <div class="field"><label for="lq-a-pass">Password</label><input id="lq-a-pass" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="At least 6 characters"></div>
            <button type="button" class="btn primary" id="lq-a-go">Sign in</button>
            <div class="msg" id="lq-a-msg" role="status"></div>
            <button type="button" class="link" id="lq-a-forgot">Forgot password?</button>
            <div class="or">or</div>
            <button type="button" class="btn google" id="lq-a-google">${GOOGLE_G}<span>Continue with Google</span></button>
            ${allowGuest ? '<button type="button" class="btn ghost" id="lq-a-guest">Play as guest</button>' : '<button type="button" class="btn ghost" id="lq-a-cancel">Close</button>'}
          </div>
          <div class="ffoot">by the New Horizons</div>
        </section>
        <section class="apane"><canvas aria-hidden="true"></canvas><p class="quote">“Every sentence you speak is a seed.”</p></section>
      `,
        true,
      );
      const stopArt = art ? art.mount(el.querySelector('canvas')) : () => {};
      const $ = (s) => el.querySelector(s);
      const say = (t, cls) => {
        const m = $('#lq-a-msg');
        m.textContent = t;
        m.className = 'msg ' + (cls || '');
      };
      const setBusy = (b) => el.querySelectorAll('button,input').forEach((x) => (x.disabled = b));
      const finish = (v) => {
        stopArt();
        el.remove();
        resolve(v);
      };
      if (disabled) el.querySelectorAll('.tabs button,#lq-a-mail,#lq-a-pass,#lq-a-go,#lq-a-google,#lq-a-forgot').forEach((x) => (x.disabled = true));
      // Nút Google ẩn cho đến khi Supabase xác nhận nhà cung cấp Google đã bật
      // (chưa bật mà bấm thì ra trang lỗi "Unsupported provider: provider is not enabled").
      if (!disabled) {
        const g = $('#lq-a-google');
        const or = $('.or');
        g.hidden = or.hidden = true;
        fetch(URL_ + '/auth/v1/settings', { headers: { apikey: ANON } })
          .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
          .then((s) => {
            if (s && s.external && s.external.google) g.hidden = or.hidden = false;
          })
          .catch(() => {});
      }
      el.addEventListener('click', async (ev) => {
        const b = ev.target.closest('button');
        if (!b || b.disabled) return;
        if (b.dataset.m) {
          mode = b.dataset.m;
          el.querySelectorAll('.tabs button').forEach((x) => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b));
          $('#lq-a-go').textContent = mode === 'in' ? 'Sign in' : 'Create account';
          $('#lq-a-pass').autocomplete = mode === 'in' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password';
          say('');
          return;
        }
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-guest') return finish('guest');
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-cancel') return finish('cancel');
        const email = $('#lq-a-mail').value.trim();
        const pass = $('#lq-a-pass').value;
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-google') {
          try {
            setBusy(true);
            const r = await client.auth.signInWithOAuth({ provider: 'google', options: { redirectTo: location.origin + location.pathname } });
            if (r.error) throw r.error;
          } catch (e) {
            setBusy(false);
            say(friendly(e), 'err');
          }
          return;
        }
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-forgot') {
          if (!email) return say('Enter your email above, then tap again.', 'err');
          try {
            setBusy(true);
            const r = await client.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { redirectTo: location.origin + location.pathname });
            if (r.error) throw r.error;
            say('Password reset email sent. Please check your inbox.', 'ok');
          } catch (e) {
            say(friendly(e), 'err');
          }
          setBusy(false);
          return;
        }
        if (b.id === 'lq-a-go') {
          if (!email || !pass) return say('Please enter your email and password.', 'err');
          if (mode === 'up' && pass.length < 6) return say('Password must be at least 6 characters.', 'err');
          try {
            setBusy(true);
            say('Working…');
            if (mode === 'in') {
              const r = await client.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password: pass });
              if (r.error) throw r.error;
              user = r.data.user;
              token = r.data.session ? r.data.session.access_token : '';
              return finish('user');
            }
            const r = await client.auth.signUp({ email, password: pass, options: { emailRedirectTo: location.origin + location.pathname } });
            if (r.error) throw r.error;
            if (r.data.session) {
              user = r.data.user;
              token = r.data.session.access_token;
              return finish('user');
            }
            say('Account created. Open your email to confirm, then come back and sign in.', 'ok');
          } catch (e) {
            say(friendly(e), 'err');
          }
          setBusy(false);
        }
      });
      el.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
        if (ev.key === 'Enter' && ev.target.tagName === 'INPUT' && !disabled) $('#lq-a-go').click();
        ev.stopPropagation();
      });
      setTimeout(() => {
        const f = disabled ? $('#lq-a-guest') : $('#lq-a-mail');
        if (f) f.focus();
      }, 60);
    });
  }
  function friendly(e) {
    const m = String((e && e.message) || e || '');
    if (/invalid login/i.test(m)) return 'Incorrect email or password.';
    if (/already registered|already been registered/i.test(m)) return 'This email already has an account. Please sign in.';
    if (/email not confirmed/i.test(m)) return 'Email not confirmed yet. Please check your inbox.';
    if (/rate limit|too many/i.test(m)) return 'Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.';
    if (/password/i.test(m)) return 'Invalid password (at least 6 characters).';
    if (/network|fetch/i.test(m)) return 'Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.';
    return m || 'Something went wrong. Please try again later.';
  }

  function chooseSave(local, cloud, why) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const el = overlay(`
        <h2>Choose which progress to use</h2>
        <p class="sub">${esc(why)}</p>
        <div class="cmp">
          <div><b>☁️ On the server (updated ${esc(fmtDate(cloud.updated_at))})</b>${esc(describe(cloud.data.data || {}))}</div>
          <div><b>💻 On this device</b>${esc(describe(local))}</div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn primary" data-c="cloud">Use server progress</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn ghost" data-c="local">Use this device's progress (overwrites server)</button>
      `);
      el.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
        const b = ev.target.closest('button');
        if (!b) return;
        el.remove();
        resolve(b.dataset.c);
      });
    });
  }

  // ---------- cloud ----------
  async function loadSdk() {
    if (window.supabase && window.supabase.createClient) return;
    // Offline or a very slow school network: give up quickly and let the game start as a guest.
    if (navigator.onLine === false) throw new Error('No Internet connection');
    await new Promise((res, rej) => {
      const s = document.createElement('script');
      const timer = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('The sign-in library took too long to load')), 8000);
      s.src = SDK;
      s.onload = () => { clearTimeout(timer); res(); };
